description: This PHP file defines the Task class within the OrangeHRM framework. The class extends the Crunz Event class and manages scheduled console tasks, including executing commands and logging errors.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: A scheduled task class that executes console commands within the OrangeHRM framework, extending the Crunz Event class and handling errors with logging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Task with an ID, command info, console, and output, setting up the command to be executed.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Executes the associated console command, returns its exit code, and logs errors if exceptions occur.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the CommandInfo object associated with this Task.
